Statement I is correct. The Andhra Desa Library Association launched the Telugu periodical Grandhalaya Sarvasvam in 1915 to promote the library movement and spread reading habits among the people. Statement II is correct. Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao Pantulu founded the famous Telugu newspaper Andhra Patrika in 1908. It became one of the most influential newspapers during the Indian National Movement and played a vital role in awakening political consciousness among Telugu-speaking people. Statement III is incorrect. Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam was not established at Kovvur in 1916. It was established in Hyderabad in 1901. The institution established at Kovvur in 1916 was the Andhra Council of Research. Statement IV is correct. In 1918, Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao introduced the innovative Boat Library Service in the Godavari region to carry books to villages located along riverbanks, thereby expanding access to education and reading.
Therefore, Statements I, II and IV are correct, making
Option (1) the correct answer.
n: Boat Library Service – Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao (1918)
Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam – Hyderabad (1901)
